closed_children.title: Gate: docs up to date (make install)

description: Add 'make install' that does a release build and drops the two v0.1 binaries (lernie, lernie-provider-anthropic) into $(INSTALL_PREFIX)/bin, defaulting to ~/.local/bin. Honors an INSTALL_PREFIX override for packagers. No symlinks — plain 'install -m 0755' copies so re-running make install after a rebuild gets a fresh binary atomically. Update README with the install instructions and point at the adapter-drop location.
title: Makefile: install target to ~/.local/bin
